"""Auditor probes (round 2), run only in the mirror."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import sys
import time

from conftest import git
from test_returns import age, items, start_and_finish


def test_p_broken_worktree_git_names_ids_unresolved(project):
    """F-6 'fails' half: git exits 128 in the worktree (its .git link broken)."""
    project.ticket("W2-1")
    project.ready(project.entry("W2-1"))
    project.tick()
    project.wait_exit("W2-1-log")
    wt = project.worktree("W2-1")
    head = git(wt, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[:12]
    (project.state / "logs" / "W2-1-log").write_text(f"status: DONE\ncommits: {head}\nfiles_changed: README\n")
    (wt / ".git").unlink()
    project.tick()
    text = items(project)[0]
    print("ITEM:\n" + text)
    print("PROBLEMS:", project.status()["problems"])


def test_p_glob_path_resolves(project):
    project.ticket("W2-1")
    project.ready(project.entry("W2-1"))
    project.tick()
    project.wait_exit("W2-1-log")
    (project.state / "logs" / "W2-1-log").write_text("status: DONE\nfiles_changed: .tickets/*.md, nothere/x.py\n")
    project.tick()
    print("ITEM:\n" + items(project)[0])


def test_p_escalation_problem_every_pass_and_read_drops(project, monkeypatch):
    start_and_finish(project)
    project.tick()
    [item] = project.inbox()
    age(item)
    project.write_config(notify_retry_s=600)
    monkeypatch.setenv("STUB_NOTIFY_EXIT", "1")
    for i in range(3):
        project.tick()
        print(i, project.status()["problems"], project.status()["ok"], project.status()["exit_code"])
    print("calls", len(project.notify_log.read_text().splitlines()))


def test_p_pass_time_with_long_record(project):
    """Ordinary months of use: N finished starts, N items written and deleted."""
    project.ticket("W2-1")
    st = project.state
    (st / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (st / "inbox" / "read").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = int(os.environ.get("PROBE_N", "3000"))
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00", time.gmtime(time.time() - 86400))
    with open(st / "started.txt", "w") as s, open(st / "items-written.txt", "w") as w:
        for i in range(n):
            s.write(f"L{i} {stamp} W2-x{i} T-x{i}\n")
            w.write(f"L{i}.return.txt {stamp}\n")
            (st / "logs" / f"L{i}.exit").write_text("0\n")
            (st / "logs" / f"L{i}").write_text("status: DONE\n")
    began = time.time()
    code, _ = project.tick()
    took = time.time() - began
    print(f"N={n} pass took {took:.2f}s code={code} inbox={len(project.inbox())}")


def test_p_never_ran_then_finishes_late(project):
    """A start reported never-ran whose session later writes its exit: both items, each once."""
    project.ticket("W2-1")
    project.state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00", time.gmtime(time.time() - 3600))
    (project.state / "started.txt").write_text(f"W2-1-log {old} W2-1 T-W2-1\n")
    project.tick()
    (project.state / "logs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (project.state / "logs" / "W2-1-log.exit").write_text("0\n")
    project.tick()
    project.tick()
    print([p.name for p in project.inbox()])

The mutation runs were per file, with `-x`, on the mirror; the mirror was restored afterwards and `diff -r` shows it identical to the tree. The six W2-96 base reds were not run (not this ticket's).

discoveries:
- A glob in `files_changed:` (e.g. `.tickets/*.md`) counts as resolved, because git reads it as a pattern that matches committed files. It is lenient only when something matches, so it is not reported as a finding.
- Re-checked and still sound:
  - the lock, and a losing pass writes nothing;
  - OFF is read before the lock;
  - the start is recorded before the spawn;
  - one start per pass, in list order, with every skip named;
  - the room formula uses the gate's floor and working size;
  - S7's round count;
  - no watcher process;
  - the status is written whole, `PASS FAILED` is the top line of a failed pass, and `status` says STALE after 3 minutes;
  - a crash between an item's write and its record is recovered by the next pass, which records the item it finds in the folder;
  - a failed notifier is retried only at `notify_retry_s` (default 600 s), not every pass;
  - a hung notifier costs one timeout per pass, after the starts.

risks:
- R2-1: pass time keeps growing for the life of the state folder. At about 15–20k starts it passes a minute, and every other cron tick then exits 4 at the lock. The status stays honest: it says STALE after 3 minutes.
- Nothing in part a writes the job history (round 1's note, out of scope). Until something does, a lead's peak is the gate's working size.

lessons: The fix moved the "already written?" check from a file-exists test to a whole-file read per item, which turned an O(1) check into an O(N) one. The fix-round tests check behaviour, not cost.
